name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
December 10, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Matt Koumaras, Executive Director of the Boys & Girls Club of Vista
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Moonlight Cultural Foundation Presentation Supporting Productions for 2013 Year
P2.
Proclamation declaring December 12, 2013, "Peppertree Frosty Day" in the City of Vista
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending October 31, 2013 (CC)
C4.
Fiscal Year 2014/2015 California Gang Reduction, Intervention, and Prevention Grant Award (CalGRIP) (CC)
C5.
2014 Scheduled Commission, Committee, and Board Vacancies (CC)
C6.
Revisions to City Council Policy 700-07, Investment City Funds (CC)
C7.
CIP Nos. 8245 and 8259 - Agreement with GHD Inc. for the Design of the Buena Creek Pump Station Electrical and Wet Well Repair Project (BSD)
C8.
Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Public Service Priorities (CC)
C9.
Purchase and Sale Agreement - Terrace Drive Property (APN 179-041-15) (CC)
C10.
Agreements with Vista Firefighters Association (VFFA), Vista City Employee Association (VCEA), Vista City Maintenance Association (VCMA), and Management and Confidential Employees (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013-   , approving a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Vista and the Vista Firefighters Association.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013-   , approving a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Vista and the Vista City Employees Association. (Recommended Action continued on following page)
(Recommended Action continued from previous page)
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013-   , approving a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Vista and the Vista City Maintenance Association; and
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013-   , amending the Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan and repealing all resolutions in conflict herewith.
5.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013-   , amending the Operating Program Budget for the 2013/14 Fiscal Year. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Appointment of a Deputy Mayor (CC)
D2.
Appointments of Officials to Boards, Committees, and Commissions (CC/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following resolutions of appointment:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- , appointing Councilmember Aguilera representative and Mayor Ritter alternate to the Board of Directors of the North San Diego County Transit District Board (NCTD);
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Mayor's reappointment of Mayor Ritter as representative and Councilmembers Cowles and Aguilera first and second alternate representatives, respectively, to the Board of Directors of the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG);
c.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- , reappointing Mayor Ritter and Councilmember Cowles representatives and Councilmember Aguilera and Sewer Program Director Putnam alternate representatives to the Board of Directors of the Encina Wastewater Authority;
d.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2013- , reappointing Chairperson Ritter and Director Cowles representatives and Director Aguilera and Sewer Program Director Putnam alternate representatives to the Board of Directors of the Encina Wastewater Authority.
2.
Confirm the Mayor's appointments to the agencies not listed above, but shown on Exhibit 5; and
3.
Direct staff to post the changes on the website on California Fair Political Practices Commission (FPPC) Form 806 in compliance with FPPC Regulation 18705.5.
D3.
Climate Action Plan (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving Addendum No. 1 to the Vista General Plan 2030; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Climate Action Plan.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Fees for City Services and Recreation & Community Services Policies and Procedures (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to consider fee changes for various city services.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving revisions to the Recreation & Community Services Program and Facility Rental fees, Building and Planning fees in the Community Development Fee Schedule, and general fees for services provided by the City Clerk.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Recreation & Community Service's Policies and Procedures.
PH2.
Conduit Financing for Caritas Affordable Housing, Inc. (CC)
1.
Conduct Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act Hearing.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the issuance of tax-exempt obligations and directing certain actions.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
